name: Dead Cells
description: Fight through the Prisoners' Quarters side by side. The Dead Cells Multiplayer Mod puts two players in the same run: the same levels, enemies and bosses, in real time.

setup.title: Dead Cells
setup.detail: Install Dead Cells from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it, and the modding API it runs on, in the game's coremod folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above. Cairn puts the mod and the Dead Cells Core Modding API in the game's coremod folder and keeps them up to date.
Press Play: Cairn starts the game through the modding API's own launcher, not through Steam directly.
In the main menu choose Play Multiplayer, then Host (Steam P2P) or Host (TCP, port 1234).
Invite your friend with the Steam overlay, or share your address and port, then pick a save slot and start the game.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, then press Play.
In the main menu choose Play Multiplayer and join through the host's Steam invite, or with the host's address and port (Join TCP).
When both of you are in the lobby the host starts the game and you spawn together.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: Play over Steam peer to peer, or by address on a local network or a virtual one. Both players need the same version of the mod.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod and the modding API it runs on in the game's folder and updates them when a new version is released.

items.name: Two players, one run
items.detail: Levels, enemies, bosses and rune progress are kept in step between the players.

items.name: Spectating and revives
items.detail: Switch the camera between players, and handle deaths and restarts together.
